subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation consume the full existing provider `request` transport object through `useConfiguredRequest`, including its private-network authorization?
rationale: The implementation is architecturally consistent, but it intentionally changes the xAI image network boundary and may activate other existing transport settings; that intent cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Approve canonical request path
options.body: Accept the full shared configured-request path after real allow-and-deny production-path proof confirms the guarded behavior.

options.title: Narrow private-network authority
options.body: Carry only the existing private-network decision if xAI image generation should not inherit other provider transport settings.

options.title: Keep images public-only
options.body: Retain the hardcoded deny if maintainers do not want xAI image generation to support private endpoints.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical request path
recommendation.body: Accept the full shared configured-request path after real allow-and-deny production-path proof confirms the guarded behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent xAI and shared image-runtime history makes this the best available owner for the cross-cutting provider and security choice.
